newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil steady, holds good price.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil steady, holds good price.

text.p: Straight-run fuel oil in Europe steadied on Thursday, holding the higher numbers it has achieved in recent days, traders said.
One cargo was reported sold on Wednesday from a British major to a Milford Haven refinery at a price below $104 cif.
A deal out of Scandinavia, may have been done to one of the big U.S. buyers for transit across the Atlantic earlier in the week. The price heard in the market was around $99 fob.
Opening offers today were reported at $99 fob for average 0.5 to 0.7 percent material with opinions divided on whether the grade's recovery has now peaked.
Some buying interest was believed apparent for mid-May.
Russian high sulphur straight-run business was quiet both in the Black Sea and the Baltics.
